title: DNA-binding and protein structure of nuclear factors likely acting in genetic information processing in the Paulinella chromatophore.
authors: Macorano, Luis; Binny, Taniya M; Spiegl, Tobias; Klimenko, Victoria; Singer, Anna; Oberleitner, Linda; Applegate, Violetta; Seyffert, Sarah; Stefanski, Anja; Gremer, Lothar; Gertzen, Christoph G W; Hoppner, Astrid; Smits, Sander H J; Nowack, Eva C M
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Paulinella色素体来源的DNA结合短蛋白（DB-sCTPs）的抗菌活性、DNA结合能力及晶体结构，并通过分子对接模拟其与DNA大沟的互作，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且含结构建模，但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟为辅。
abstract: The chromatophores in Paulinella are evolutionary-early-stage photosynthetic organelles. Biological processes in chromatophores depend on a combination of chromatophore and nucleus-encoded proteins. Interestingly, besides proteins carrying chromatophore-targeting signals, a large arsenal of short chromatophore-targeted proteins (sCTPs; <90 amino acids) without recognizable targeting signals were found in chromatophores. This situation resembles endosymbionts in plants and insects that are manipulated by host-derived antimicrobial peptides. Previously, we identified an expanded family of sCTPs of unknown function, named here "DNA-binding (DB)-sCTPs". DB-sCTPs contain a ~45 amino acid motif that is conserved in some bacterial proteins with predicted functions in DNA processing. Here, we explored antimicrobial activity, DNA-binding capacity, and structures of three purified recombinant DB-sCTPs. All three proteins exhibited antimicrobial activity against bacteria involving membrane permeabilization, and bound to bacterial lipids in vitro. A combination of in vitro assays demonstrated binding of recombinant DB-sCTPs to chromatophore-derived genomic DNA sequences with an affinity in the low nM range. Additionally, we report the 1.2 A crystal structure of one DB-sCTP. In silico docking studies suggest that helix alpha2 inserts into the DNA major grove and the exposed residues, that are highly variable between different DB-sCTPs, confer interaction with the DNA bases. Identification of photosystem II subunit CP43 as a potential interaction partner of one DB-sCTP, suggests DB-sCTPs to be involved in more complex regulatory mechanisms. We hypothesize that membrane binding of DB-sCTPs is related to their import into chromatophores. Once inside, they interact with the chromatophore genome potentially providing nuclear control over genetic information processing.
abstract_zh: Paulinella中的色素体（chromatophores）是进化早期的光合作用细胞器。色素体中的生物学过程依赖于色素体编码蛋白和核编码蛋白的组合。有趣的是，除了携带色素体靶向信号的蛋白质外，在色素体中还发现了一大类缺乏可识别靶向信号的短色素体靶向蛋白（sCTPs；<90个氨基酸）。这种情况类似于植物和昆虫中由宿主来源的抗菌肽操控的内共生体。此前，我们鉴定了一个功能未知的sCTP扩展家族，此处命名为“DNA结合（DB）-sCTPs”。DB-sCTPs包含一个约45个氨基酸的基序，该基序在预测具有DNA加工功能的某些细菌蛋白中保守。在此，我们探索了三种纯化的重组DB-sCTPs的抗菌活性、DNA结合能力和结构。所有三种蛋白均表现出对细菌的抗菌活性，涉及膜透化作用，并在体外与细菌脂质结合。一系列体外实验表明，重组DB-sCTPs以低纳摩尔范围的亲和力与色素体来源的基因组DNA序列结合。此外，我们报告了一种DB-sCTP的1.2 Å晶体结构。计算机模拟对接研究表明，螺旋α2插入DNA大沟，而暴露的残基（在不同DB-sCTPs之间高度可变）赋予与DNA碱基的相互作用。将光系统II亚基CP43鉴定为一种DB-sCTP的潜在相互作用伙伴，表明DB-sCTPs可能参与更复杂的调控机制。我们假设DB-sCTPs的膜结合与其进入色素体的导入相关。一旦进入内部，它们与色素体基因组相互作用，可能提供核对其遗传信息加工的控制。
